import BoundedQueue.Spec

namespace BoundedQueue

def step : Impl
  | s, .enqueue x =>
    if s.items.length < s.capacity then
      (.ok, { s with items := s.items ++ [x] })
    else
      (.rejected, s)
  | s, .dequeue =>
    match s.items with
    | [] => (.rejected, s)
    | x :: rest => (.got x, { s with items := rest, served := s.served + 1 })

theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_capacity        : CapacityBound step := sorry
theorem req_enqueue_effects : EnqueueEffects step := sorry
theorem req_dequeue_effects : DequeueEffects step := sorry
theorem req_fifo            : Fifo step := sorry

end BoundedQueue

import BoundedQueue.Spec

namespace BoundedQueue

def step : Impl
  | s, .enqueue x =>
    if s.items.length < s.capacity then
      (.ok, { s with items := s.items ++ [x] })
    else
      (.rejected, s)
  | s, .dequeue =>
    match s.items with
    | [] => (.rejected, s)
    | x :: rest => (.got x, { s with items := rest, served := s.served + 1 })

theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := by
  intro s op h
  cases op with
  | enqueue x =>
    simp [Valid] at h
    simp [step, h]
  | dequeue =>
    simp [Valid] at h
    cases hitems : s.items with
    | nil => contradiction
    | cons x rest =>
      simp [step, hitems]

theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s op h
  cases op with
  | enqueue x =>
    simp [Valid] at h
    simp [step, h]
  | dequeue =>
    simp [Valid] at h
    cases hitems : s.items with
    | nil =>
      simp [step, hitems]
    | cons x rest =>
      simp [hitems] at h

theorem req_capacity : CapacityBound step := by
  intro s op hle
  cases op with
  | enqueue x =>
    by_cases h : s.items.length < s.capacity
    · have e : step s (.enqueue x) = (.ok, { s with items := s.items ++ [x] }) := by simp [step, h]
      rw [e]
      simp
      omega
    · have e : step s (.enqueue x) = (.rejected, s) := by simp [step, h]
      rw [e]
      simp
      exact hle
  | dequeue =>
    cases hitems : s.items with
    | nil =>
      have e : step s .dequeue = (.rejected, s) := by simp [step, hitems]
      rw [e]
      simp
      exact hle
    | cons x rest =>
      have e : step s .dequeue = (.got x, { s with items := rest, served := s.served + 1 }) := by simp [step, hitems]
      rw [e]
      simp
      have hlen : (x :: rest).length ≤ s.capacity := by rw [← hitems]; exact hle
      simp at hlen
      omega

theorem req_enqueue_effects : EnqueueEffects step := by
  intro s x hne
  by_cases h : s.items.length < s.capacity
  · simp [step, h]
  · simp [step, h] at hne

theorem req_dequeue_effects : DequeueEffects step := by
  intro s hne
  cases hitems : s.items with
  | nil =>
    simp [step, hitems] at hne
  | cons x rest =>
    exact ⟨x, rest, rfl, by simp [step, hitems]⟩

theorem req_fifo            : Fifo step := sorry

end BoundedQueue
